# Magazine cover — Style Prompt

> The speaker becomes the cover of a magazine. A punchy, saturated grade; across the top, a giant masthead in a heavy black sans, red, wide as the frame, with the person's head in front of its lower edge; a small issue line above it; a stack of cover lines on the left from the middle of the frame down (one italic serif lead in yellow, then short heavy capitals in white); a small barcode bottom right. The cover holds; each beat swaps the cover lines.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **A cover, not a title card.** Masthead, issue line, cover lines and barcode all appear together within 0.35 s and stay; the speaker keeps talking inside the cover.
2. **Masthead behind the head.** The masthead is between the room and the person (cutout), so the head overlaps it like a cover star.
3. **Cover-line hierarchy.** One big italic serif lead (yellow), then two or three small heavy caps lines (white), left-aligned, from half the frame's height.
4. **A made-up magazine.** The masthead is the business's, creator's or story's own word; never a real magazine's name, logo or layout.

Not a news lower third (nothing slides from the bottom, no bars). Not a poster (the footage is live and the speaker talks). Not the editorial look (no serif masthead, no rule, no soft film bloom) unless the brand asks for it; see Variation below.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Footage**: the user's clip from `list_media` with a static "pop" grade on its wrapper (`filter: saturate(1.35) contrast(1.12)`, set once, never tweened), full bleed 9:16. Reframe so the head's top sits about two thirds down the masthead (craft `reframe.md`).
- **Person**: the clip's cutout from `make_cutout` (`assets/media/cut_….webm`, same timing, cutoutTiming) above the masthead. Without a cutout, place the masthead entirely above the hair.
- **Stand-in** (example only): a warm room (wall, floor lamp, bookshelf, wooden floor) in CSS gradients and a flat SVG person, painted in the pop grade.
- **Masthead**: SVG `<text>` with `textLength` 92 % of the width, so any brand font fits exactly; height capped at 24 % of the frame.
- **Barcode**: a white block 16 × 9 % of the width with black bars 2/2/3/5 px wide and 2–4 px gaps from a seeded PRNG, 18 px clear at the bottom (where digits would be).
- **Scrims**: a top gradient (40 % `--latar` to clear over 24 % of the height) under the issue line, and a soft radial `--latar` pool (52 %) under the cover lines; the lines also carry a 10 px `--latar` shadow.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--utama-di-latar` is the masthead (the source's red `#e82434`).
- `--aksen-di-latar` is the italic lead (the source's yellow `#ffd60a`).
- `--teks` is the white of the issue line and the caps lines; `--latar` their shadows and the scrims.
- `--kertas` and `--tinta` (white, black) are the barcode: fixed in every brand.
- The footage keeps its own colours (`--r-*`, `--k-*` in the example).
- A light brand turns the scrims pale and the lines dark; the masthead and lead fall back to colours that read on light.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the masthead (heavy, upper case, about 390 px, stretched to 994 px, baseline y 400) and the caps cover lines (49 px, 4.5 % of the width, line-height 1.55, upper case).
- `--font-miring` (a look token) carries the lead: italic serif, 92 px (8.5 % of the width), line-height 1.3. Playfair Display italic in the example (the source uses a condensed italic serif); Cormorant Garamond italic also suits.
- `--font-isi` carries the issue line: 27 px (2.5 % of the width), monospace, 600, letter-spaced 2 px, centred at the top: "EDISI … · NO. 12 · 2026".
- Archivo Black in the example; Bebas Neue or Oswald 700 suit a narrower masthead.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Cover in**: masthead drops from its own height above (−330 px) to place and fades in over 0.35 s `power3.out`; issue line, top scrim and barcode fade in over the same 0.35 s.
- **Cover lines**: each slides 60 px from the left and fades in over 0.3 s `power3.out`, starting 0.15 s after the beat, 0.08 s apart.
- **Beat change**: lines fade out in 0.2 s before the cut; the next set slides in. Masthead, issue line and barcode never move again.
- **Cut framing**: the example alternates the footage framing 1.0 / 1.06 on each beat (a jump cut); masthead and person move together, the cover lines and barcode do not.
- Every set of lines holds ≥ 3.3 s; the last set ≥ 2 s to the end.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked medium shot, head under the masthead | the cover star | every beat |
| Masthead dropping in 0.35 s | the issue opens | the hook |
| Jump cut 1.0 ↔ 1.06 on the beat | next cover story | each new set of lines |
| Lines sliding from the left | the cover sells its stories | facts, proof, offers |

## 7. Native moves

- **You on the cover.** The speaker framed under a giant masthead in their brand colour. *Fits content like:* a café's name; a creator's channel word; a class's name ("KELAS"); a family story's surname.
- **Cover lines that sell.** An italic lead plus three caps lines, all short. *Fits content like:* "Dari dapur / JADI KAFE / PALING RAMAI"; "4.800 cangkir / TERJUAL / BULAN INI"; "Juara 1 / LOMBA SAINS / SE-KOTA"; "Bab 3 / RUMAH / YANG HILANG".
- **The issue line.** A small mono line over the masthead naming the edition. *Fits content like:* "EDISI KOPI RUMAHAN · NO. 12 · 2026"; "EDISI PROMO GAJIAN"; "EDISI UJIAN AKHIR"; "EDISI SPESIAL ULANG TAHUN".
- **Barcode sign-off.** The barcode in the corner makes any ending a "buy this issue". *Fits content like:* an offer with a price; a launch date; a pre-order.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Real magazine names, fonts or layouts**: never; the masthead is the user's own word.
- **Masthead over the face**: the masthead is behind the person only with a cutout; reframe so the eyes stay below its baseline.
- **Long mastheads**: 3–7 letters; at 92 % width a long word gets thin.
- **Lines over the face**: they start at half the frame height; keep the face above y ≈ 900.
- **Too many lines**: four lines at most per beat (one lead, three caps); longer copy reads as a page.
- **Performance**: grade as a static filter only; masthead and barcode drawn once.

## Measured from the references

From the source's effect code (1080 × 1920): pop grade = saturation 1.35, contrast 1.12, mixed in at 60 % over 0.35 s; masthead red (232, 36, 52), heavy sans fit to 92 % of the width, height ≤ 24 % of the frame, top at 3.5 % of the height, sliding down from its own height over 0.35 s (cubic out), behind the person; issue line monospace 2.5 % of the width, white, shadow 3, centred at 3 % of the height; cover lines from 50 % of the height at x 5 %: lead italic serif 8.5 % of the width in yellow (255, 214, 10), then heavy sans 4.5 % in white with shadow 5, each sliding 60 px over 0.3 s from 0.15 s, 0.08 s apart; barcode 16 % × 9 % of the width at (95 % W − its width, 93 % H − its height); everything fades out over the last 0.2 s.

## Variation

The source's second look ("editorial"): a soft warm film grade with a gentle bloom, a classic bold serif masthead letter-spaced 4 % at 16 % of the height, a thin rule under it, an issue line in a light sans, an italic and a bold rose serif line on the left from 57 % of the height and two italic lines on the right from 71 %. Use `--font-judul` as the serif, `--utama-di-latar` for the rose line and `--teks` for the ink when a brand is elegant rather than loud.

# Magazine cover: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.5, medium 3.5, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: the cover forms in 0.35 s: masthead drops behind the head, issue line, barcode; four cover lines slide in, italic lead first
- id: sampul terbentuk 0,35 dtk: nama majalah turun di belakang kepala, garis edisi, barcode; empat baris sampul masuk, judul miring dulu

## problem

- en: cover lines as the issue's problem story: italic lead names it, caps lines give the stakes
- id: baris sampul jadi cerita masalah edisi ini: judul miring menyebutnya, baris kapital memberi taruhannya

## fact

- en: the fact as a cover story: italic lead is the headline, caps lines the detail; masthead and barcode stay
- id: fakta jadi cerita sampul: judul miring berita utamanya, baris kapital rinciannya; nama majalah dan barcode tetap

## step

- en: cover lines as a numbered list ('3 cara …' in italic, then one caps line per step)
- id: baris sampul jadi daftar bernomor ('3 cara …' miring, lalu satu baris kapital per langkah)

## compare

- en: italic lead 'X vs Y', caps lines with the verdict; jump-cut the framing on the turn
- id: judul miring 'X vs Y', baris kapital berisi putusannya; bingkai lompat saat berbalik

## number

- en: the figure as the italic lead (the biggest line), caps lines say what it counts
- id: angkanya jadi judul miring (baris terbesar), baris kapital menyebut yang dihitung

## proof

- en: result as the cover story: the figure in the italic lead, how and when in caps lines
- id: hasil jadi cerita sampul: angkanya di judul miring, bagaimana dan kapan di baris kapital

## offer

- en: product name in the italic lead, price and limit in caps lines; the barcode sells the 'issue'
- id: nama produk di judul miring, harga dan batasnya di baris kapital; barcode menjual 'edisi' ini

## cta

- en: italic invitation, then address, hours, contact in caps lines; the full cover held 2 s
- id: ajakan miring, lalu alamat, jam buka, kontak di baris kapital; sampul utuh diam 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: the closing cover: italic lesson, caps lines with the issue's takeaway, held 2 s
- id: sampul penutup: pelajaran miring, baris kapital berisi inti edisi, diam 2 dtk

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Sampul majalah</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Playfair Display"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #141012; --latar-2: #2a2224; --utama: #e82434; --aksen: #ffd60a;
        --teks: #ffffff; --teks-redup: #d8d0c8; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff; --teks-di-aksen: #141012;
        --utama-di-latar: #e82434; --aksen-di-latar: #ffd60a;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        /* Gaya ini: judul miring serif untuk baris sampul pertama, kertas dan tinta barcode. */
        --font-miring: "Playfair Display", "Noto Sans", serif; --kertas: #ffffff; --tinta: #000000;
        /* Rekaman pengganti dengan grade "pop" (saturasi 1,35, kontras 1,12): warna tetap, seperti footage pengguna. */
        --r-dinding: #f1d6a8; --r-dinding2: #d9a86a; --r-kap: #fff3dc; --r-kayu: #b0743c; --r-rak: #8a5428; --r-lantai: #9a5a2c;
        --r-buku1: #c8463a; --r-buku2: #2f6f8f; --r-buku3: #e9b23c;
        --k-kulit: #c98a5e; --k-kulit2: #a86a43; --k-rambut: #1e1410; --k-baju: #1f5a45; --k-tepi: #e8efe9;
        --k-bibir: #9c4446; --k-mata: #1b1310; --k-putih: #f6efe6;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .cam { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 540px 640px; }
      /* Ruang pengganti terang: dinding hangat, lampu berdiri dengan kap, rak, lantai kayu. */
      .ruang { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 300px 560px, var(--r-kap), transparent 520px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--r-dinding2), var(--r-dinding) 40%, var(--r-dinding2)); }
      .lantai { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 1560px; bottom: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--r-lantai) 0 120px, var(--r-kayu) 120px 126px); }
      .kap { position: absolute; left: 110px; top: 470px; width: 380px; height: 230px; background: var(--r-kap); clip-path: polygon(14% 0, 86% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
      .kaki { position: absolute; left: 140px; top: 700px; width: 320px; height: 900px; background: linear-gradient(60deg, transparent 48.5%, var(--r-kayu) 48.5% 51.5%, transparent 51.5%), linear-gradient(-60deg, transparent 48.5%, var(--r-kayu) 48.5% 51.5%, transparent 51.5%); }
      .rak { position: absolute; left: 850px; top: 520px; width: 300px; height: 1050px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(var(--r-rak) 0 16px, transparent 16px 220px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--r-buku1) 0 30px, var(--r-buku2) 30px 52px, var(--r-buku3) 52px 84px, var(--r-rak) 84px 96px); }
      .orang { position: absolute; left: 0; top: -268px; width: 1080px; height: 2400px; z-index: 20; overflow: visible; }
      .kulit { fill: var(--k-kulit); } .kulit2 { fill: var(--k-kulit2); } .rambut { fill: var(--k-rambut); } .baju { fill: var(--k-baju); }
      .tepi { fill: none; stroke: var(--k-tepi); stroke-width: 9; } .alis { fill: none; stroke: var(--k-rambut); stroke-width: 12; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .hidung { fill: none; stroke: var(--k-kulit2); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .putih { fill: var(--k-putih); } .mata { fill: var(--k-mata); } .bibir { fill: var(--k-bibir); }
      /* Atas sampul: garis edisi kecil lalu nama majalah raksasa selebar 92 %, di belakang kepala. */
      .atas { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 10; background: linear-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 40%, transparent), transparent 24%); }
      .mast { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; z-index: 11; overflow: visible; }
      .mast text { font-family: var(--font-judul); fill: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .edisi { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 44px; z-index: 12; text-align: center; font: 600 27px/1 var(--font-isi); letter-spacing: 2px; white-space: pre;
        color: var(--teks); text-shadow: 0 2px 6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, transparent); }
      /* Baris sampul di kiri, mulai setengah tinggi frame: serif miring kuning, lalu sans hitam tebal putih. */
      .bayang { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 30; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 760px 520px at 120px 1130px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 52%, transparent), transparent 100%); }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 40; visibility: hidden; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      .baris { position: absolute; left: 54px; top: 960px; }
      .baris div { width: max-content; white-space: nowrap; font: 400 49px/1.55 var(--font-judul); color: var(--teks); text-transform: uppercase;
        text-shadow: 0 3px 10px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 75%, transparent); }
      .baris div:first-child { font: italic 400 92px/1.3 var(--font-miring); text-transform: none; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      .barcode { position: absolute; left: 853px; top: 1689px; width: 173px; height: 97px; z-index: 45; background: var(--kertas); }
      .barcode rect { fill: var(--tinta); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="cam" id="cam">
        <!-- Footage pengguna: satu <video> klip upl_… dari list_media dengan filter statis saturate(1.35) contrast(1.12) di wrapper;
             nama majalah di antara footage dan cutout video cutout cut_… dari make_cutout (di tempat .orang). -->
        <div class="ruang"><div class="lantai"></div><div class="kaki"></div><div class="kap"></div><div class="rak"></div></div>
        <div class="atas"></div>
        <div class="edisi">EDISI KOPI RUMAHAN  ·  NO. 12  ·  2026</div>
        <svg class="mast" id="mast" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920"><text x="540" y="400" text-anchor="middle" textLength="994" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="390">RACIK</text></svg>
        <svg class="orang" viewBox="0 0 1080 2400">
          <path class="rambut" d="M330 900 C300 1100 280 1250 330 1330 L750 1330 C800 1250 780 1100 750 900 Z" />
          <path class="baju" d="M100 2400 L150 1380 Q175 1220 330 1180 L440 1150 Q540 1210 640 1150 L750 1180 Q905 1220 930 1380 L980 2400 Z" />
          <path class="kulit" d="M330 1180 L440 1150 Q540 1225 640 1150 L750 1180 L720 1250 Q540 1330 360 1250 Z" />
          <path class="tepi" d="M352 1236 Q540 1330 728 1236" />
          <path class="kulit2" d="M478 990 L474 1150 Q540 1200 606 1150 L602 990 Z" />
          <g id="kepala">
            <path class="kulit" d="M540 660 C646 660 702 742 702 868 C702 990 636 1070 540 1070 C444 1070 378 990 378 868 C378 742 434 660 540 660 Z" />
            <path class="rambut" d="M352 1000 C320 760 410 600 548 600 C686 600 768 740 730 1000 C716 860 690 760 640 712 C590 760 470 780 400 760 C372 820 360 900 352 1000 Z" />
            <path class="alis" d="M438 820 q34 -16 70 -6 M572 814 q36 -10 70 6" />
            <g id="mata"><ellipse class="putih" cx="474" cy="866" rx="29" ry="16" /><ellipse class="putih" cx="606" cy="866" rx="29" ry="16" />
              <circle class="mata" cx="476" cy="866" r="13" /><circle class="mata" cx="604" cy="866" r="13" /></g>
            <path class="hidung" d="M540 884 q-10 40 -20 52 q14 9 30 2" />
            <ellipse class="bibir" id="mulut" cx="540" cy="986" rx="44" ry="20" />
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="bayang"></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"><div class="baris"><div>Dari dapur</div><div>jadi kafe</div><div>paling ramai</div><div>di gang kami</div></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="proof"><div class="baris"><div>4.800 cangkir</div><div>terjual</div><div>bulan ini</div><div>tanpa iklan</div></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="offer"><div class="baris"><div>Menu baru</div><div>es kopi pandan</div><div>Rp18rb</div><div>minggu ini saja</div></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s4" data-role="cta"><div class="baris"><div>Mampir, yuk</div><div>Jl. Melati 7</div><div>buka 07.00–22.00</div><div>Chat 0812-3456-7890</div></div></div>
      <svg class="barcode" id="barcode" viewBox="0 0 173 97"></svg>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Barcode: garis 2/2/3/5 px dengan jarak 2-4 px, dari PRNG berbiji (sama di pratinjau dan render).
      let seed = 1;
      const acak = () => { seed |= 0; seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
        t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      const bc = document.getElementById("barcode");
      for (let x = 8; x < 165; ) {
        const w = [2, 2, 3, 5][Math.floor(acak() * 4)];
        const r = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect");
        r.setAttribute("x", x); r.setAttribute("y", 6); r.setAttribute("width", Math.min(w, 165 - x)); r.setAttribute("height", 73);
        bc.appendChild(r);
        x += w + 2 + Math.floor(acak() * 3);
      }
      // Orang pengganti: kepala mengangguk pelan, berkedip, mulut bicara (jeda di antara kalimat).
      const JEDA = [[3.7, 4.1], [7.6, 8.0], [11.4, 11.8], [14.0, 15]];
      function hidup(t) {
        const diam = JEDA.some(([a, b]) => t > a && t < b);
        gsap.set("#mulut", { scaleY: diam ? 0.15 : 0.2 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 13.3) * Math.sin(t * 4.4 + 0.9)), transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#kepala", { rotation: 1.8 * Math.sin(t * 1.2 + 0.4), y: 8 * Math.sin(t * 2.4), svgOrigin: "540 1100" });
        const k = ((t + 1.2) % 3.3) / 0.16;
        gsap.set("#mata", { scaleY: k < 1 ? 1 - 0.9 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI) : 1, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
      }
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      hidup(0);
      tl.to(jam, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => hidup(jam.t) }, 0);
      // Sampul terbentuk dalam 0,35 dtk: nama majalah turun setinggi dirinya, garis edisi dan barcode muncul.
      tl.fromTo("#mast", { y: -330, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);
      tl.fromTo([".edisi", ".atas", "#barcode"], { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);
      // Tiap ketukan: baris sampul bergeser 60 px dari kiri dan muncul 0,3 dtk, mulai 0,15 dtk, jarak 0,08 dtk;
      // pudar 0,2 dtk sebelum ketukan berikutnya; bingkai lompat 1 / 1,06 di tiap potongan.
      const KETUK = [["#s1", 0, 4.0, 1], ["#s2", 4.0, 7.9, 1.06], ["#s3", 7.9, 11.7, 1], ["#s4", 11.7, 15, 1.06]];
      KETUK.forEach(([s, a, b, zoom], i) => {
        if (i) tl.set(KETUK[i - 1][0], { visibility: "hidden" }, a).set(s, { visibility: "visible" }, a).set("#cam", { scale: zoom }, a);
        document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelectorAll(".baris div").forEach((el, j) => {
          tl.fromTo(el, { x: -60, opacity: 0 }, { x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power3.out" }, a + 0.15 + 0.08 * j);
        });
        if (i < KETUK.length - 1) tl.to(document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelector(".baris"), { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, b - 0.2);
      });
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines.main = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Barcode: garis 2/2/3/5 px dengan jarak 2-4 px, dari PRNG berbiji (sama di pratinjau dan render).
      let seed = 1;
      const acak = () => { seed |= 0; seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
        t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      const bc = document.getElementById("barcode");
      for (let x = 8; x < 165; ) {
        const w = [2, 2, 3, 5][Math.floor(acak() * 4)];
        const r = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect");
        r.setAttribute("x", x); r.setAttribute("y", 6); r.setAttribute("width", Math.min(w, 165 - x)); r.setAttribute("height", 73);
        bc.appendChild(r);
        x += w + 2 + Math.floor(acak() * 3);
      }
      // Orang pengganti: kepala mengangguk pelan, berkedip, mulut bicara (jeda di antara kalimat).
      const JEDA = [[3.7, 4.1], [7.6, 8.0], [11.4, 11.8], [14.0, 15]];
      function hidup(t) {
        const diam = JEDA.some(([a, b]) => t > a && t < b);
        gsap.set("#mulut", { scaleY: diam ? 0.15 : 0.2 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 13.3) * Math.sin(t * 4.4 + 0.9)), transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#kepala", { rotation: 1.8 * Math.sin(t * 1.2 + 0.4), y: 8 * Math.sin(t * 2.4), svgOrigin: "540 1100" });
        const k = ((t + 1.2) % 3.3) / 0.16;
        gsap.set("#mata", { scaleY: k < 1 ? 1 - 0.9 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI) : 1, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
      }
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      hidup(0);
      tl.to(jam, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => hidup(jam.t) }, 0);
      // Sampul terbentuk dalam 0,35 dtk: nama majalah turun setinggi dirinya, garis edisi dan barcode muncul.
      tl.fromTo("#mast", { y: -260, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);
      tl.fromTo([".edisi", ".atas", "#barcode"], { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);
      // Tiap ketukan: baris sampul bergeser 60 px dari kiri dan muncul 0,3 dtk, mulai 0,15 dtk, jarak 0,08 dtk;
      // pudar 0,2 dtk sebelum ketukan berikutnya; bingkai lompat 1 / 1,06 di tiap potongan.
      const KETUK = [["#s1", 0, 4.0, 1], ["#s2", 4.0, 7.9, 1.06], ["#s3", 7.9, 11.7, 1], ["#s4", 11.7, 15, 1.06]];
      KETUK.forEach(([s, a, b, zoom], i) => {
        if (i) tl.set(KETUK[i - 1][0], { visibility: "hidden" }, a).set(s, { visibility: "visible" }, a).set("#cam", { scale: zoom }, a);
        document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelectorAll(".baris div").forEach((el, j) => {
          tl.fromTo(el, { x: -60, opacity: 0 }, { x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power3.out" }, a + 0.15 + 0.08 * j);
        });
        if (i < KETUK.length - 1) tl.to(document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelector(".baris"), { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, b - 0.2);
      });
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines.main = tl;
    </script>
